Arm Block.name: Arm Block
Arm Block.special: If success, attack is blocked by arm or forearm and damage is reduced to 1/2.

Leg Block.name: Leg Block
Leg Block.special: If success, attack is blocked by thigh or shin and damage is reduced to 1/2.

Body Block.name: Body Block
Body Block.special: If success, attack is blocked by a torso and damage is reduced to 1/2.
